Name: Tenkai Backpacks 0.3.5 Beta
Author: TENKAITENSHI
Description:
[b]TENKAI BACKPACKS[/b]
144 Slots and Visible Backpacks
Author: Tenkai Tenshi | Version 0.3.5 beta | English and Spanish

Carry more resources, tools, and food on your adventures. Tenkai Backpacks adds five upgrades purchased from Pierre's backpack stand that expand your farmer's regular inventory. Each tier has its own appearance on your character's back, from a leather backpack to a legendary 144-slot pack.

[b]FEATURES[/b]

[list]
[*]Five backpack tiers: Leather, Forest, Miner, Iridium, and Legendary.[/*]
[*]Up to 144 regular inventory slots: four times the vanilla maximum of 36.[/*]
[*]Buying an upgrade automatically equips the new backpack and replaces the previous tier.[/*]
[*]Permanent forward progression: purchase the next tier without downgrading to earlier backpacks.[/*]
[*]Backpack textures with back, side, and front-strap views.[/*]
[*]Separate Backpack and Profile & equipment views within the inventory menu.[/*]
[*]A 16-column × 9-row legendary inventory, with slot size adapted to the window.[/*]
[*]English and Spanish interface text, selected through the game's language.[/*]
[/list]
[b]THE FIVE UPGRADES[/b]

These capacities start from the vanilla 36-slot backpack. Each price is the cost of that individual upgrade, paid in gold and purchased in order.

Leather: 48 slots — 15,000g
Forest: 72 slots — 40,000g
Miner: 96 slots — 80,000g
Iridium: 120 slots — 150,000g
Legendary: 144 slots — 250,000g

The Legendary Backpack provides 300% more space than the vanilla maximum. Upgrading preserves the items you already carry. Your previous tier is replaced automatically and does not remain as an item taking up a slot.

[b]GETTING STARTED[/b]

1. Buy Pierre's two normal backpack upgrades first, reaching 36 slots.
2. Interact with the original backpack stand inside Pierre's shop.
3. Choose the next tier and confirm the purchase. You must be inside the shop between 9:00 AM and 5:00 PM and have enough gold.
4. Your new backpack is equipped automatically, expands your inventory, and changes its appearance on your farmer.

Press K during gameplay with other menus closed to view the catalogue. You can also click the backpack equipment slot in Profile & equipment while your cursor is empty. Purchasing still requires being in Pierre's shop and meeting the conditions above.

[b]BACKPACK AND PROFILE[/b]

The Backpack view dedicates its space to your items. The legendary inventory displays all 144 slots in a 16 × 9 grid at the tested resolutions: 1920×1080, 1280×720, and 1024×600. The arrangement stays consistent when the resolution changes; the slot size adapts.

Profile & equipment contains your portrait, clothing, accessories, money, and character information. Your name appears above the portrait and the automatic backpack slot below it. To equip clothing or an accessory, pick it up from the backpack, switch to the profile, and click its equipment slot. Reverse the process to return it to your inventory.

Organizing, trashing, splitting stacks, and moving items use the game's normal actions. Chests and shops retain their native player-inventory panels, with row scrolling through the mouse wheel, arrows, or Page Up/Page Down.

Items retain their normal stack limits. This mod increases the number of available slots; it does not increase stack sizes.

[b]BACKPACK APPEARANCE[/b]

Each tier has its own design. The backpack follows your farmer's movement and is hidden while swimming, bathing, or in bed. The included version fixes the backpack separating from the body when kissing to the left and follows the torso's lateral tilt adjustments.

[b]REQUIREMENTS AND INSTALLATION[/b]

Declared requirements: Stardew Valley 1.6.14 or later and SMAPI 4.3.0 or later.
Tested environment: Windows, Stardew Valley 1.6.15, and SMAPI 4.5.2.

1. Install SMAPI if you have not already.
2. Close the game, then extract the TenkaiBackpacks folder from the ZIP into Stardew Valley/Mods.
3. Launch the game through SMAPI.

When updating, replace the mod files while keeping config.json and your existing configuration. The catalogue key is configured through OpenCatalogueKey in config.json; its initial value is K.

[b]EXISTING SAVES AND COMPATIBILITY[/b]

The purchased tier and inventory slots are stored with the farmer's normal save data. Existing purchases from earlier versions retain their tier after updating; for example, an early 96-slot Legendary Backpack can expand to 144 slots without another purchase.

Combinations with other mods that expand or replace inventory, equipment, or farmer rendering require specific testing. Multiplayer and other operating systems have not been fully validated. This is a beta release.

The version passes 147 automated native checks and a startup check with the local mod collection. Gallery images are demonstrations rendered by the game using temporary characters and items. Validation does not cover a full in-game day or every combination of mods and animations in a real save.

[b]REMOVING THE MOD[/b]

Before uninstalling, empty every slot from 37 onward, close the menus, and run tenkai_mochilas_prepare_remove in the SMAPI console. If it confirms the normal capacity has been restored, save the game before removing the mod. The command refuses removal while additional items remain or an unrelated capacity expansion needs review. Removing the mod directly leaves the extra slots outside the vanilla menu's visible area.

[b]CREDITS[/b]

Mod by Tenkai Tenshi. The original backpack artwork was created with AI assistance and adapted into the mod's sprites. Includes 20 directional frames and five original icons. Stardew Valley: ConcernedApe. SMAPI: its team and contributors.
